liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Sugaree** (1 review): The first set features a strong but somewhat short performance of this song [12]
- **Cumberland Blues** (1 review): The pairing of Cumberland Blues into Mexicali Blues is highlighted as a treat [12]
- **The Other One** (1 review): This performance was the favorite, featuring a very spacey jam and weird vocal effects [22]

## The recordings

- **gd1987-08-12.142089.fob.oade.schoeps.cmc3.mk41.jacobs.miller.clugston.flac1644** (recommended): audience recording; 23 songs; 140 min [1]
- **gd1987-08-12.sbd.miller.95684.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 20 songs; 139 min; rated 4.2/5 by 5 [2]
- **gd1987-08-12.163610.senn.me80.hessberg.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 20 songs; 139 min [4]
- **gd1987-08-12.nak100.pasternak.81967.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 20 songs; 134 min [7]
- **gd1987-08-12.nakcm304.beckham.suraci.82054.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 20 songs; 131 min; rated 4.25/5 by 4 [10]. Said about its sound: Clear vocals and Phil's thunder are audible, with some hiss during quiet moments [12]
- **gd1987-08-12.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.81677.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 19 songs; 137 min; rated 3.5/5 by 8 [11]. Said about its sound: The soundboard transfer is described as excellent [16]

## Around the show

- Brent sings well, Jerry sounds wonderful, and the band rocks out with great vibes [13]
- Clouds parted over the hill behind the amphitheater right before the first set [17]
- It was rainy or threatening to rain when fans were let into the venue [17]
- The reviewer was up front with friends from Crested Butte, noting Bobby was intense [18]
- Few audience sources rival the Walker-Scotton-Miller release; this is the only serious one [14]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1987-08-12.142089.fob.oade.schoeps.cmc3.mk41.jacobs.miller.clugston.flac1644**: taped by Oade Brothers; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller and Blake Jacobs; source: Source Info: Oade's Master (FOB) Audience PCM; Schoeps CMC3/MK41 mics > Oade M118 > Oade modified Sony PCM-F1; Transfer Info: Master Oade PCM > Sek'd Prodif >… [1]
- **gd1987-08-12.sbd.miller.95684.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master [2]. Also: Lineage is SBD to Cassette Master to Cassette, with pitch correction by Joe B. Jones [2]
- **gd1987-08-12.163610.senn.me80.hessberg.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Michael Hessberg; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Michael Hessberg's Master Audience Cassettes; Sennheiser ME80 mics > Sony D5M [4]. Also: Schoeps CMC4 MK41 source supplies a 0:34 patch in the Space section [4]
- **gd1987-08-12.nak100.pasternak.81967.sbeok.flac16**: source: Nakamichi CM-100's with CP-4 shotgun capsules > Marantz 420 cassette deck, with Dolby On [7]. Also: Same source as ShnID-14911, but with MAC to CD lineage; Soundforge used to make fades and clean up around tape flips [7]
- **gd1987-08-12.nakcm304.beckham.suraci.82054.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Don Beckham - Tony Suraci; source: Nak CM304's>Sony D5M [10]
- **gd1987-08-12.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.81677.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Cassette (Maxell XLIIS) [11]
